data.gender_notes: Ariselle is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ariselle is derived from the Greek word 'arise', meaning 'to exalt' or 'to be high'. This name is associated with the Greek goddess Aphrodite, who was revered for her beauty and grace. In Christian tradition, Ariselle represents the majesty and venerability of God and the spiritual exaltation of those who follow Him. The name Ariselle carries the meaning “Majestic, Venerable” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Ariselle usually hope their child will grow to embody majestic, venerable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
